area.title: My account
area.description: Your own profile and sign-in, the same in every organisation you belong to.

profile.label: Profile
profile.line: Your name, photo and email address.

security.label: Security
security.line: Two-step verification, passkeys and your password.

data.label: Data & Privacy
data.line: Download your data, or delete your account.

photo.notImage: Choose an image file: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF.
photo.tooLarge: That image is over 8 MB. Choose a smaller one.
photo.unreadable: That image couldn't be read. Try another file.

details.title: Personal details
details.description: How you appear to the people in your organisations, and the address you sign in with.
details.name: Name
details.nameHint: Shown on your profile, in member lists and in the audit log.
details.emailHint: You sign in with it, and password resets go to it.

email.title: Change your email address
email.description: We'll send a 6-digit code to the new address. You keep signing in with {{email}} until you confirm it.
email.invalid: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
email.same: That's the address you use now.
email.codeDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it to make this your sign-in address.

about.title: About this account
about.accountIdHint: Quote it if you contact support.
about.noneHint: Create one, or join one you're invited to.

security.title: Security
security.description: How you sign in, and what protects your account. Your organisation's rules are set by its administrators.
security.lastMethod: It's your only way to sign in. Add a passkey or a password before removing it.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.description: A second step after your password, so a stolen password isn't enough.

app.name: Authenticator app
app.line: Codes from an app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password
app.setupDescription: Scan the code with your app, or type the key into it. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
app.replaceTitle: Set up your new authenticator app
app.replaceDescription: Scan the code with the new app, or type the key into it. Your current app keeps working until you confirm this one.
app.replaceConfirmDescription: You'll scan a new code with the new app. The one you use now keeps working until you confirm it.
app.turnOffConfirmDescription: Its codes stop working, and so do your recovery codes. If your organisation requires a second step, you'll be asked to set one up when you next sign in.
app.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
app.keyHint: Can't scan it? Type this setup key into the app instead.
app.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from the app.

codes.name: Recovery codes
codes.line: {{remaining}} of {{total}} left · for when you can't use the others
codes.lineNone: Codes to sign in with when you can't use the others
codes.newConfirmDescription: The codes you have now stop working. Save the new ones somewhere safe.
codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.description: Each code signs you in once if you can't use your app or phone. We won't show them again.
codes.saved: I've saved these codes somewhere safe

phone.title: Link a phone
phone.description: Open Qeet Auth on your phone, go to Settings and scan this code. It links one phone, once.
phone.qrLabel: QR code to link a phone with Qeet Auth
phone.orType: Or type this code in the app:
phone.expired: This code has expired. Get a new one to link your phone.
phone.linked: Phone linked. It can now approve your sign-ins.
phone.line: Approves your sign-ins · linked {{linked}} · last used {{used}}

otp.title: Add a number or email
otp.description: We'll send a code there when you sign in.
otp.removeDescription: Codes stop going there. Your other ways to sign in keep working.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your face, fingerprint or device PIN. Nothing to remember, nothing to phish.
passkeys.addDescription: Your browser will ask you to confirm with your face, fingerprint or device PIN.
passkeys.nameHint: Leave it empty to name it after this browser. You can rename it later.
passkeys.cancelled: The passkey wasn't created. You can try again.
passkeys.disabled: Your organisation has turned off passkeys, so you can't add one.
passkeys.removeDescription: You can no longer sign in with it. Add it again to use it.

password.title: Password
password.description: Used with your email address. A passkey is safer: it can't be phished.
password.name: Password
password.line: Change it if you think someone else knows it.
password.lineNone: You sign in with a passkey or a connected account. Add a password as a backup.
password.addDescription: Then you can also sign in with your email address and this password.
password.forgot: Forgotten it? Email me a reset link
password.resetSent: We've emailed a reset link to {{email}}.

devices.title: Remembered devices
devices.description: Browsers you chose to remember skip the second factor when you sign in, until they expire. Forget any you no longer use or don't recognise; it's asked for the second factor next time.
devices.memberDescription: Browsers this person chose to remember in your organisation skip the second factor until they expire. Forget any that may be lost or compromised.
devices.forgetDescription: It will be asked for the second factor at its next sign-in.
devices.forgetAllDescription: Each will be asked for the second factor at its next sign-in.
devices.shortDescription: These skip two-step verification until they expire.

phones.title: Linked phones
phones.description: Phones with the Qeet Auth app approve your sign-ins. Remove any you no longer have; it stops approving at once.
phones.memberDescription: Phones this person linked to approve their sign-ins. Remove one that may be lost or stolen; their other factors stay.
phones.removeDescription: It stops approving your sign-ins at once. Link it again to use it.
phones.removeMemberDescription: It stops approving this person's sign-ins at once. Their other factors stay.

dialog.description: Open Qeet Auth on your phone, go to Settings and scan this code. It links one phone, once.
dialog.expired: This code has expired. Get a new one to link your phone.
dialog.linked: Phone linked. It can now approve your sign-ins.
dialog.orType: Or type this code in the app:
dialog.title: Link a phone

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.description: Sign in with one of these instead of your password.
connected.disconnectDescription: You can no longer sign in with it. Connect it again to use it.
connected.alreadyLinked: That account is already connected to a different Qeet ID.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Where you're signed in. Sign out of anything you don't recognise.

others.title: Other sessions
others.description: Each one is a browser or app still signed in as you.
others.empty: No other sessions are signed in as you.
others.confirmTitle: Sign out of all your other sessions?
others.confirmDescription: Every session except this one ends and can no longer be renewed, including any not listed here. A device that is signed in may keep access for a few more minutes, until its current access runs out. You stay signed in here.
others.none: There were no other sessions to sign out of
others.failed: Couldn't sign out your other sessions. Try again.
others.unrecognised: Don't recognise one? Sign out of it, then change your password or remove the passkey it used in <security>Security</security>.
others.doneDescription: They can no longer renew their access. Access they already hold runs out within a few minutes.

signOut.label: Sign out of {{device}}
signOut.title: Sign out of {{device}}?
signOut.description: Whoever is using it is signed out at once.

everywhere.title: Sign out everywhere
everywhere.description: Lost a device? This ends every session, this one included, signs you out of the Qeet ID sign-in page in any browser, and out of the apps you use with this account.
everywhere.confirmDescription: Every session ends, this one included, and none can be renewed: your devices, the Qeet ID sign-in page in any browser, and the apps you signed in to with this account. Your remembered devices are forgotten too. A device or app that is signed in may keep access for a few more minutes, until its current access runs out. You will need to sign in again.
everywhere.failed: Couldn't sign you out everywhere. You are still signed in here; try again.
everywhere.doneDescription: None of them can be renewed. Access a device or app already holds runs out within a few minutes.

data.title: Data & Privacy
data.description: A copy of what we hold about you, and how to delete it.

export.title: Download your data
export.description: A JSON file with your profile, sessions, passkeys and organisation roles.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Erases your name, email, phone and sign-in methods, and signs you out. Audit records keep a redacted reference so administrators can still check past events. This can't be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: Your personal data and sign-in methods are erased and you're signed out at once. This can't be undone.
